configure_tta_model: configure a DetTTAModel with NMS settings and max_per_img for RetinaNet test time augmentation
configure_img_scales: configure multi-scale image resizing with scales (1333,800), (666,400), and (2000,1200) for TTA
configure_tta_pipeline: configure a TTA pipeline with LoadImageFromFile, Resize, RandomFlip, LoadAnnotations, and PackDetInputs transforms
configure_test_time_aug: configure TestTimeAug with multiple Resize scales, RandomFlip variations, and annotation loading for detection
configure_pack_det_inputs: configure PackDetInputs with meta_keys including img_id, img_path, ori_shape, img_shape, scale_factor, flip, and flip_direction
